ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast; approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels in the lateral lobe regions vs 40% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central peduncle area and trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Bilateral large white regions occupying the mid-to-distal sections of both lobes. Significant black encroachment (mottling) occurs from the medial notch area and along the dorsal-facing trailing edge boundary. Small, discrete black pixel clusters (focal spots) are scattered within the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45-50 degrees; depth is significant relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is greatest at the distal tips, transitioning to smaller, jagged 'saw-tooth' variations toward the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the outer leading edges, tapering to narrow, upturned points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct golden-yellow circular clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the outer distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, vertical dark linear pixel disruptions visible within the lower-left white pigmentation patch, suggestive of minor rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of Coronula-type barnacle clusters on the extreme tips; irregular, jagged trailing edge profile suggesting natural wear and minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'islanding' effect where the black pigmentation from the central region transitions into the white areas with a complex, fractal-like boundary.
